rules: Source-defined customer, property, parcel, jurisdiction and system identities remain explicit. Stable system/customer and currency bind every job revision; property equals original booking location.

Arrival promises retain exact accepted window, agreement time and authorization. Booking revisions name their accepted promise; changed schedule and original promise compare without inferred permission.

Field record versions retain captured time and later observed/sync time, exact booking revision, predecessor, arbitrary original field-value JSON, customer notes and distinct internal notes. Latest observed version is current; every prior body remains.
Field statuses are draft, final or voided. Final is the source field-record disposition and does not prove physical completion, which remains an independent completion record.

Templates retain original jurisdiction/form/version, original document URL/hash when supplied and explicit source-declared role list. Empty role list means unspecified requirements, not legal completeness.

Form instances bind the exact field record version and template version and retain the source-reported artifact digest. Later field corrections do not silently rewrite a signed or filed artifact. The instance created_at and later observed_at are both retained; as-of visibility follows observed_at.

Signature events bind original signature identity, instance, role and signer, with signed, declined or revoked outcome and observation time. A signature state is compared only at its recorded observation; it is never treated as legal validation.

Filing attempts retain exact form instance, destination, channel, submission time, observation time and authorization. Separate events are delivered, acknowledged, accepted, rejected or withdrawn; accepted/rejected/acknowledged need the actual receipt reference.

All observation histories are selected at the explicit as-of instant. Physical capture, submission, delivery, acknowledgement, acceptance, completed work, invoice issuance and payment remain separate. Within observed filing responses, current agency decision follows occurred_at; delivery and acknowledgement have their own retained events, so delayed transport or older agency callbacks cannot erase a newer decision.

Current source comparisons flag arrival beyond the accepted window, older-booking field records, superseded field bodies under a retained form, missing or revoked source-declared signature roles, repeated filings and later conflicting filing outcomes.
No live dispatch, signing, filing, customer communication, payment, AI diagnosis or regulatory inference. Independent explicit source exports and authored operating examples only.

Complete offline/browser/native copies retain source editions, original byte receipts, unfinished forms and source-specific review corrections. Monetary arithmetic remains exact integer minor units in explicit currencies.
